Subject: SIG/CAIQ call request + initial question workbook

Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Atlantech is starting a security intake for our procurement review team. We prefer a short kickoff call to walk through the CAIQ + SIG overlap and to confirm the evidence cadence. Can you do a 30-minute call next week? Our preferred windows: Tue 12/8 between 10:00-12:00 PST or Wed 12/9 between 13:00-16:00 PST.

Attached is our initial question workbook (atlantech-sig-questions-v1.xlsx) — it's a superset of CAIQ questions mapped to our procurement controls. For planning, could you confirm:
- A target turn-around for Q/A answers (days per question or per section)
- The logs/sample artifacts you can provide by the kickoff (if any)
- Any immediate blockers for a SOC 2 scope conversation

Best,
Peter

Peter — thanks for the workbook and the window options. We can do Tue 12/8 at 10:30 PST (30 minutes). I’ve provisionally booked that slot; Marissa will send a calendar invite with a meet link.

Quick answers up front:
- Turn-around: For the CAIQ/SIG combined workbook our team typically targets 5 business days for sections we own end-to-end, and 7-10 business days for items requiring engineering artifacts or log pulls. We’ll triage the workbook at kickoff and mark high-priority questions for a faster path.
- Logs/artifacts we can share by kickoff: a 48-hour sample of anonymized request logs and a sanitized KV-cache telemetry snippet (we'll attach a zip). We'll also bring a sample auth trace and our data residency summary.
- SOC 2 blockers: none expected for an intake — we can discuss scope if Atlantech needs evidence tied specifically to a Type II window.

Prep items we need from Atlantech before the call:
1) Confirm the sig sections you want prioritized (or flag must-answer questions in the workbook)
2) Any regulatory constraints on sample logs (redaction guidance)
3) A point-of-contact for legal/procurement to join follow-ups (if different from security@atlantech.com)

I’m attaching the items we'll bring to the call: redwood-logs-sample-202611.zip (stub) and a short intake template.

See you Tue — 
Hannah
Security Intake Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-logs-sample-202611.zip (ZIP, 1.2MB)
